devdoc.details: Manages the presale of tokens with configurable parameters

EnforcedPause().details: The operation failed because the contract is paused.

ExpectedPause().details: The operation failed because the contract is not paused.

OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

Paused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is triggered by `account`.

Unpaused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is lifted by `account`.

constructor.details: Constructor initializes the contract with the deployer as the owner

createPresale(address,address,uint256,ui.details: Creates a new presale with the specified parametersInitial state: presaleEndTime is set to _tgeTimestamp to maintain the invariant      that presaleEndTime <= tgeTimestamp. Owner can adjust presaleEndTime later via setPresaleEndTime()

params._presaleTokenSupply: Total supply of tokens for the presale
params._rewardPerBlock: Reward rate per block (used for frontend/UI display only)
params._tgeTimestamp: Timestamp for the Token Generation Event
params._token: Address of the token being sold
params._trustedSigner: Address of the signer authorized to sign presale transactions

getPresaleDetails().details: Gets the details of the presale

returns.supply: Total supply of tokens for the presale
returns.tgeTime: Time of the Token Generation Event
returns.tokenAddr: Address of the token being sold

getPresaleStatus().details: Gets the current status of the presale

isPresaleActive().details: Checks if the presale is currently active

returns._0: bool True if presale is active, false otherwise

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setPresaleEndTime(uint256).details: Sets the end time for the presaleInvariant: presaleEndTime must be <= tgeTimestamp (enforced via require statement)

params._presaleEndTime: New end time for the presale

setTgeTimestamp(uint256).details: Sets the timestamp for the Token Generation EventEnforces invariant: presaleEndTime must be <= tgeTimestamp      If presaleEndTime would be violated, it is automatically adjusted to _tgeTimestamp

params._newSigner: Address of the new trusted signer

tgeHasOccurred().details: Checks if the TGE has occurred

returns._0: bool True if TGE has occurred, false otherwise

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

devdoc.title: PresaleManager

setRewardPerBlock(uint256).notice: This value is stored for frontend/UI display purposes only and is not enforced in any contract logic
